item.title: Emergency Road Closure on Houghton Road After Lorry Damage
item.description: Emergency repair works have forced the closure of Houghton Road between the junctions of Albert Street and Edward Street after a lorry caused significant damage to the carriageway and a manhole cover. item.title: Stamford man pleads guilty to nine counts of rape
item.description: A man accused of raping four women has pleaded guilty to his crimes.
